words.gloss_range: resumptive-resultative connector; sequence and consequence are both active in the ayah boundary
words.prose: The opening {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the ayah enter as consequence: the crushed-mountain scene of 56:5 is not left behind but carried into a fresh clause as its result. Because the connector is a bound first beat on the following becoming-verb, the relation is heard before the state itself, so the clause begins with linkage, then moves to becoming, residue, and dispersal.

topics.headline: resultative sequence across the ayah boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 56:6 is not a new isolated picture, but the immediate result of the crushing in 56:5.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as resumptive-sequential, and the local clause is licensed as a resultive predication after the prior crushing scene.

topics.headline: bound first beat makes relation precede state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin with the relation itself before the becoming predicate unfolds.
topics.reason: The particle is a proclitic opening attached to the verb, so its structural payoff is the compressed boundary relation at the start of the clause.

words.gloss_range: perfect copular or existential becoming with an accusative predicate; locally it presents an accomplished resultant state
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurrence, and predication are locally active; place, suretyship, idiom, and other remote branches are not selected by this form
words.prose: {{ar:كَانَتْ}} ({{tr:kānat}}) turns the prior event into a completed state: the subject has come to be residue, not merely undergone another narrated action. Its feminine ending silently carries a prior feminine referent forward, but the guardrail evidence keeps that referent open between the immediately accessible scene elements rather than forcing one explicit noun. The root of being gives the change ontological weight here, while the local perfect predicate frame narrows that broad field to accomplished transformation into dust and dispersal. Even the open vowel gives the becoming beat a brief widening before the dust predicate arrives.

topics.headline: perfect predicate frame presents completed transformation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the clause reports an accomplished resultant state rather than another action in progress.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect and governs an accusative predicate, so the local frame supports completed becoming or resultant predication rather than a pleonastic or action-verb reading.

topics.headline: feminine agreement imports a prior referent without naming it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader has to recover the subject from the preceding scene while noticing that the Arabic leaves the exact recovery grammatically open.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix and omitted subject create real backward pressure, but attachment evidence marks the referent as ambiguous between accessible prior candidates, so rows that force only the mountains are narrowed.

topics.headline: being-root narrowed to dissolution grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a common being verb becomes the grammar by which stable existence is recast as particulate residue.
topics.reason: The broad root field supports being and predication, but local form and syntax do not activate remote place, suretyship, or idiom branches; the surviving payoff is the being-root placed under a dissolution predicate.

topics.headline: state-change hinge in the local sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verb as a hinge from kinetic crushing into a static aftermath and then toward the next ayah's classification.
topics.reason: The local clause shifts from the eventive destruction of 56:5 to nominal residue beats, and the same root returns in 56:7 for human classification.

topics.headline: open vowel stretches the becoming beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear a brief acoustic widening before the dust predicate arrives.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is local to the surface form and adds a modest sound-shape payoff without changing the grammar.

words.gloss_range: fine scattered dust or threshold-visible motes, functioning here as the indefinite accusative predicate of becoming
words.root_gloss_range: dust rising or shining in air and fine scattered motes are locally active; ash, empty-handed idiom, fleeing, and dying remain outside the selected local sense
words.prose: {{ar:هَبَآءًۭ}} ({{tr:habāʾan}}) names the substance of the aftermath: the known solid scene has become an indefinite mass-state, not an object receiving another action. Its rare dust-mote sense matters because it points to fine, threshold-visible residue rather than ordinary soil, so the previous crushing reaches an endpoint of almost ungraspable particles. The same rare form links physical unmaking here with the nullification of deeds in 25:23, while the long vowel, hamza, and tanwin give the residue phrase an airy opening and a clipped close before the final dispersal modifier.

topics.headline: indefinite predicate turns identity into mass residue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the former subject is reclassified as unbounded residue rather than described as a stable named thing.
topics.reason: The noun is the accusative predicate of the becoming verb and is indefinite, so it functions as a mass-state label rather than an acted-on object.

topics.headline: rare motes-word narrows dust to fine visible residue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the residue as fine suspended motes at the edge of visibility, not generic earth or dust.
topics.reason: V4 supports dust rising in air and fine motes, while the local noun does not select remote ash, idiom, fleeing, or dying branches; the surviving specificity is fine visible particulate residue.

topics.headline: predicate resolves prior crushing into residue
topics.reader_payoff: The reader learns what the crushing in 56:5 was moving toward: not broken pieces, but fine particulate residue.
topics.reason: The predicate occupies the central result position after the boundary connector and names the residue produced by the prior event.

topics.headline: rare form links physical and moral nullification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same rare residue word joins cosmic matter here to deeds made null in 25:23.
topics.reason: The bundle reports only two occurrences of the same form, including 25:23, so the cross-passage echo is concrete and limited to a shared nullification image.

topics.headline: sound shape opens then clips the residue word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the residue word widen, stop, and then pass into the paired indefinite dispersal phrase.
topics.reason: The sound rows are local to the surface and are reinforced by the shared accusative tanwin with the following modifier.

words.gloss_range: dispersed, spread-out, scattered; locally an indefinite accusative passive participial adjective qualifying the dust noun
words.root_gloss_range: physical spreading and scattering are locally active; disclosure, grief outpouring, broadcast, and investigative branches are secondary coloring only, not the selected sense
words.prose: {{ar:مُّنۢبَثًّۭا}} ({{tr:munbaththan}}) closes the ayah by turning the dust predicate into a state scene: the residue exists as dispersed, spread-out matter. Its participial form makes scattering a condition borne by the dust rather than a new finite act with a named agent, and its agreement with the dust noun keeps the modifier attached to that residue. The root image gives outward, uncontained spread; broader disclosure, grief, or broadcast branches only color the idea of uncontrolled release. The variant pressure toward severance sharpens the same final state without replacing the canonical dispersal reading, while the doubled fricative and nasal liaison make the final phrase sound bound and continuously scattered. The marked scatteredness also sits with eschatological parallels in 101:4 and 88:16, completing the move from pulverizing to spread-out aftermath before the reclassification of 56:7.

topics.headline: passive participle makes dispersal a settled condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah closes on the dust's condition, not on a newly narrated scattering action.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify an indefinite accusative passive participle qualifying the dust noun, so the grammar supports a final-state modifier.

topics.headline: root image gives outward uncontained spread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader imagines the residue distributed outward and no longer held together, not merely reduced to smallness.
topics.reason: V4 supports physical spreading and scattering as the locally coherent branch; disclosure, grief, broadcast, and investigation branches are narrowed to coloring around uncontrolled outward release.

topics.headline: variant pressure adds severance without replacing dispersal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register a variant pressure in which spread-out residue is also cut off from its former continuity.
topics.reason: The qiraat rows are useful as apparatus and contrast, but the canonical local parse remains the scattering root and passive participial modifier.

topics.headline: marked dispersal register across end-time scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this passive-participle scatteredness belongs to a marked eschatological register also visible in 101:4 and 88:16.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence reports low occurrence and adjective behavior, and the CRITICAL rows give concrete eschatological parallels in 101:4 and 88:16.

topics.headline: sound and liaison bind the dispersal modifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the modifier attach to the dust noun while the doubled fricative prolongs the sense of spreading.
topics.reason: The sound rows are local to the surface and reinforce the syntactic attachment already established by agreement.

topics.headline: prior reduction resolves as spread-out aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sequence advance from pulverizing to the spread-out condition that remains.
topics.reason: The final participle is the grammatical endpoint of the prior destruction sequence and prevents 56:6 from simply repeating the crushing action.

topics.headline: dispersal precedes the next ayah's sorting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that loss of coherent matter in 56:6 stands just before human classification in 56:7.
topics.reason: The row points to the immediate next ayah, so the forward pressure is local and concrete.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predication kaanat habaa'an munbaththan makes an implicit feminine subject enter a dust-state qualified by dispersal.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal coming-to-be converts a bounded but unnamed subject into fine matter; the adjective makes loss of cohesion, not dust alone, the endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time make the clause a realized state transition.
Fine, dispersed motes supply the particulate state into which the subject passes.
Spreading and scattering material make de-cohesion the operative result.

changed_reading.before: An unnamed subject simply becomes dust.
changed_reading.after: An unnamed subject undergoes a completed phase change from coherent form into mobile, unbound particles.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Habaa'an and munbaththan combine airborne dust with active diffusion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dust branches couple rising material with motes disclosed by light, while the dispersal branch distributes them through a field of view. The transition therefore produces a new visibility regime as well as residue.

activation_trace.role: Dust rising in air supplies suspension and upward mobility.
Fine motes seen in a shaft of light make dispersion an act of particulate disclosure.
Material spread turns isolated dust into a pervasive visible field.

changed_reading.before: The dust is inert residue lying where it fell.
changed_reading.after: The dust is suspended and distributed, so former solidity survives only as innumerable visible traces.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The habaa' predicate admits both spent ash and the image of empty hands.
baseline_models.mechanism: The state change can register terminal exhaustion: substance cools into residue, mixes with earth, and leaves nothing graspable to retain.

activation_trace.role: Coming to be marks the residue as an achieved terminal condition.
Extinguished ash mixed with soil supplies the image of spent material.
Hands shaken empty convert material exhaustion into dispossession.

changed_reading.before: Becoming dust describes only reduction in particle size.
changed_reading.after: Becoming dust also images extinguishment and the loss of anything that can still be possessed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence identifies an elevated solid mass and supplies a process: a severe event agitates it, crumbling and mixing destroy its internal cohesion, and 56:6 states the resulting aerosolized residue.

activation_trace.role: Fine dispersed dust supplies the process endpoint.
Scattering carries the comminuted residue away from its former mass.
The severe descending event supplies the initiating rupture.
Agitation until disturbance supplies the first mechanical operation.
Crumbling, wetting, and mixing supply the loss of internal binding.
An elevated solid aggregate identifies the coherent input destroyed by the process.

structural_cues: Ayat 56:4-6 form a process sequence: intensified shaking, intensified crumbling, then resultative fa- in 56:6; feminine singular kaanat resumes the nonhuman plural mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a severe event, repeated agitation, crumbling and mixing, and an elevated solid mass; I infer the arrow agitation -> comminution -> airborne residue. A live alternative is that the ayat enumerate concurrent signs rather than a mechanical chain.

changed_reading.before: An unidentified entity becomes scattered dust without a stated pathway.
changed_reading.after: The mountains are processed from resistant elevated aggregates into fine mobile matter through a staged collapse of cohesion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The vertical pair of lowering and raising, the mountain's elevated solidity, and the split-root image of spreading over level ground activate a topological reading: height is converted into a horizontally undifferentiated particulate field.

activation_trace.role: Fine motes provide the level field's undifferentiated units.
Lateral spreading removes the particles from a single elevated center.
The alternate mapped image of extension in a level place supplies an exploratory spatial endpoint.
Lowering after height supplies the downward transformation.
Raising establishes the vertical axis that the dusting of heights disrupts.
The elevated solid aggregate supplies the height and differentiation being nullified.

structural_cues: The lowering/raising pair in 56:3 precedes the named high masses in 56:5 and their dispersed state in 56:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an alternate mapped branch of level extension, a down/up pair, and elevated solidity; I infer a height-to-field arrow. The alternate mapping may be form-distant, and lowering/raising may concern rank rather than geometry.

changed_reading.before: Scattering is random motion after breakage.
changed_reading.after: Scattering materially abolishes vertical distinction, turning what dominated the horizon into an even field of particles.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate repetition of the becoming construction links two contrary reorganizations: the mountains lose all grouping into scattered particles, then the human audience acquires grouping as three kinds.

activation_trace.role: Material scattering supplies the ungrouping side of the contrast.
A second realized state transition links human classification to the material transition.
Kinds or classes supply the regrouping that follows material dispersal.
The number three makes the new human order explicit and bounded.

structural_cues: Ayah 56:7 immediately follows 56:6 and repeats k-w-n in the perfect while changing from an implicit nonhuman subject to second-person plural.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent state changes, first dispersion and then threefold grouping; I infer a contrastive arrow from material ungrouping to human regrouping. The live alternative is a simple subject shift with no designed parallel.

changed_reading.before: The dust-state is the end of order.
changed_reading.after: The dust-state is a threshold: one old order is dissolved immediately before persons are sorted into a new, explicit order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later images systematically restore relations absent from dust: a gathered group, tight interweaving, mutual facing, and circulation around a center. Cohesion is not erased universally; it is withdrawn from the old landscape and reassigned to an ordered community.

activation_trace.role: Unbounded spreading supplies the decentered pole of the mechanism.
A gathered group restores collective cohesion after particulate dispersal.
Tight interwoven construction supplies material binding as the inverse of dust.
A group facing one another converts proximity into reciprocal social order.
Circulation around a center replaces uncontrolled diffusion with directed motion.

structural_cues: After the 56:6 dispersal and 56:7 classification, 56:13-17 accumulates gathering, interweaving, face-to-face arrangement, and centered circulation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathered, interwoven, mutually facing, and orbiting configurations; I read their accumulation as a designed inverse of decentered dust. They may instead be independent descriptions of reward with no backward pressure on 56:6.

changed_reading.before: Dust signifies a universal collapse of structure.
changed_reading.after: Dust marks selective de-structuring: old material cohesion vanishes while a new social and spatial cohesion is assembled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later accounting frame contrasts what receives a due return with what is cast aside as uncounted. Read backward, the empty-handed dust-state is not only physical waste but the cancellation of a former structure's claim to lasting value.

activation_trace.role: Empty hands supply the focus image of dispossession and failed retention.
Returning an action's due establishes the positive accounting pole.
Purposeful action identifies what remains legible for recompense.
A discarded thing not taken into account supplies the negative valuation pole.

structural_cues: Ayah 56:24 explicitly links recompense to what people were doing, and 56:25 immediately excludes laghw from the resulting domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompensed action, purposeful work, uncounted discard, and the focus image of empty hands; I infer that physical residue also signals devaluation. The alternative is that laghw governs speech alone and contributes no material analogy.

changed_reading.before: The dust is merely leftover matter.

strongest_changes: Ayat 56:4-6 convert a generic dust-state into a causal sequence from resistant height through agitation and comminution to airborne residue.
The repeated k-w-n construction at 56:7 makes material dispersion a threshold immediately followed by threefold human classification.
Gathering, interweaving, mutual facing, and centered circulation in 56:13-17 relocate cohesion rather than letting 56:6 mean undifferentiated chaos alone.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supported linked changes in material topology, social sorting, visibility, containment, and valuation while remaining anchored in kaanat, habaa', and munbaththan.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Solid mass becomes visible particulate spread.** `ه ب و` **B001** supplies bright rising dust and **B002** fine scattered motes; `ب ث ث` **B001** supplies spreading a thing out. The preceding crushing gives the cause, while the later gathered multitude at a fixed time (56:49–50) gives a reverse motion. **Abductive move:** I infer that dispersion here is a phase in a larger disperse/gather sequence. **Reading change:** the ayah presents matter made individually visible before reassembly.

2. **Outward scattering as disclosure.** `ب ث ث` **B002** is disclosing what is hidden in the self and **B003** investigating and exposing a matter. The immediate move from dispersed dust to three human kinds makes this branch functional. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies physical dispersion and social classification; I infer that what is spread is thereby exposed to view. **Reading change:** pulverization doubles as revelation of concealed distinctions.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The lossless gathering of first and later people at 56:49–50 corrected any reading of dispersion as final annihilation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A former structure survives only as visible dispersion.** `ك و ن` (B001, being or temporal predication) marks the mountains’ changed state as `ه ب و` (B002, fine scattered dust motes) qualified by `ب ث ث` (B001, spreading a thing out). Ayat 4–5 supply the force and pulverization; ayah 7 immediately converts “you” into three classes. I infer a contrast between material declassification and human reclassification. What was one massive landmark becomes innumerable particles just before humanity’s apparent mass is separated into accountable groupings.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 56:60–61 joins measured death to replacement and unknown re-origination, sharpening dispersion as a transition between orders rather than a claim that dissolution ends agency.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak deyimi, bir seyi dagitma, ortaya cikararak yayma, savurma veya canlilari yeryuzune salip cogaltma ekseninde tutarlidir. Provisional cerceve bu fiziksel dagitma ve yayma cekirdegini, atlar, kopekler, cekirge, toz, yiyecek ve insanlar gibi farkli nesnelere uygulanisini dogru bicimde kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir seyi tek yerde toplu veya gizli halde birakmayip parcalara, yonlere ya da alana dagitmak; buna bagli olarak nesnenin yayilmasi, savrulmasi, aciga cikmasi veya canlilarin yeryuzunde cogalip dagilmasi anlatilir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, bir seyi ayirip farkli yonlere veya alana dagitmaktir.
Dagitma, nesnenin ortaya cikmasi, yayilmasi, savrulmasi veya yerinden kaldirilip hareketlendirilmesi sonucunu dogurabilir.
Atlari veya av kopeklerini salmak gibi kullanimlarda dagitma, canlilari belli bir is icin alana yaymaktir.
Hurma, yemek, dosek, cekirge, kelebek veya toz gibi nesnelerde anlam daginik, serpilmis, cok veya savrulmus duruma yonelir.
Yaratilmis varliklar icin kullanim, onlarin yeryuzune yayilmasini ve cogalmasini anlatir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak deyimi, belirli yinelenmis fiil kalibinda haberin yayilmasi, tozun kaldirilmasi, bir isin arastirilip yoklanmasi ve aciga cikarilmasi kullanimlarini bir araya getirir. Provisional cerceve, bu dalin ana dagitma veya ic keder dalindan farkli olarak kalipla sinirli oldugunu dogru belirtir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalniz belirli kalipli kullanimdir; genel fiziksel dagitma veya ic kederi acma anlami buraya genellenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik sinir collocation oldugu icin tanim, sadece haber, toz veya isin bu belirli kalipli kullanimdaki yayma, yoklama ve aciga cikarma anlamini kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yinelenmis fiil kalibinda bir haberi yaymak veya tozu kaldirip savurmak; is ve mesele baglaminda ise onu arastirip yoklamak ve sakli yanini aciga cikarmak anlatilir.

facets.statement: Dal, belirli kalipli kullanimla sinirlidir ve genel kok anlaminin tamamini temsil etmez.
Haber baglaminda anlam, haberi yaymak veya duyurmaktir.
Toz baglaminda anlam, tozu kaldirip savurmaktir.
Is veya mesele baglaminda anlam, arastirmak, yoklamak, haberini almak ve aciga cikarmaktir.
Kanit, bu kalibin ana fiilden ses degisimiyle aciklandigini da bildirir; bu bilgi anlami genel dala geri tasimaz.
